comment: Agent SoW: the signed acts of 6.3 (agentsow.com 0.35.0-draft). Each act is a JSON object with a closed member set: engagement, version, digest ('sha256:' and the lowercase hex SHA-256 of that version's signed bytes, 6), the kind's own members, by (the seat that signs), key (that seat's owner_key), signed_at and sig (canonical padded base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature). Its signed bytes are the kind's tag, one newline, and the JCS of the act minus sig: agent-sow-terminate-v1, agent-sow-usage-v1, agent-sow-settlement-v1, agent-sow-dispute-v1, agent-sow-resolve-v1 and agent-sow-acceptance-v1. A settlement record, an acceptance act and a dispute are named by the digest of its signed bytes; a verdict by the digest of its own signed bytes (agent-arbiter-verdict-v1, one newline, JCS minus signatures). Each case names the act, its kind, the document it is made under, and for a resolve the dispute and verdict it rests on; prior lists usage acts the runtime already holds; for a settlement record, held lists the usage acts the runtime holds and earlier the settlement records it already holds. An earlier list may name the record being checked, which the runtime then holds already and compares with nothing, and records under other engagements, which settle nothing for this one (6.3). quote names an entry of quotes, the quote the charge followed (5.5.8), where the runtime holds one; a case without it holds none. unsettled is what remains unsettled under every engagement here when its dispute opens. pairs pin when a dispute under escalate_to_owners closes. For an acceptance act, delivered_at is the instant the task that delivered the deliverable completed, earlier lists the acceptance acts the runtime already holds, and acceptance_signed_bytes pins one act's signed bytes and digest; an act an agent drafted carries proposed, checked as the Common Agent Specification 7.9 says (common-agent/conformance/draft-approval.json). The keys are published test seeds (sha256 of the label); 'arbiter' plays the arbiter, whose verdict signature is in the role's own encoding, base64url, as sow-disputes.json pins it. THE FIXTURE IS THE AUTHORITY: change it only with a spec change alongside.
